headline: Indian Aluminium Product Manufacturers Demand Duty-Free Primary Metal Imports
summary: The Aluminium Secondary Manufacturers Association urged India's Finance Ministry to abolish the 7.5% basic customs duty on primary aluminium ahead of the FY28 budget, citing margin pressures on MSMEs.
why: India is a major consumer and producer of aluminium, with tariff policy directly altering raw material costs for downstream manufacturing.

impacts.name: India
impacts.why: Removing primary aluminium import duties would lower input costs for small industrial manufacturers.
